title: The tests against the guardless rules
why: Open 1, New 1, Miss 2, Reach 2; about 14 test files, 300 lines, no rule changed. Every fix is named in the brief; the model reads a failing assert and changes the test, not the rule. The risk is a test bent to pass: the brief names the expected behaviour for each.

title: Review the piece
why: The whole step built the rules, the planner, the page and the scores (scores.md) and build-1 the tests. A cold reader checks each Decided line against its test, reads the played games, and judges one thing the builds couldn't: a led civ that raises no army loses its capital within a few turns of the pick (progress.md). The verdict says whether that is the game the design asks for.
